set -euo pipefail; DB="$HOME/agent-workspace/review/photomap-2026-09-12/app.db"; DB="$DB" python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(os.environ['DB'])
c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
rows=c.execute("SELECT p.id,p.slug,p.title,p.description,p.photo_count,p.cover_photo_id,c.name AS city_name FROM place p JOIN city c ON c.id=p.city_id WHERE p.status='published' ORDER BY CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(p.description,''))='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, length(coalesce(p.description,'')), p.photo_count ASC, p.title LIMIT 12").fetchall()
for r in rows:
    photos=c.execute("SELECT id,caption,thumb_path FROM photo WHERE place_id=? AND status='approved' ORDER BY CASE WHEN id=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, approved_at, created_at LIMIT 3",(r['id'],r['cover_photo_id'])).fetchall()
    print(json.dumps({'id':r['id'],'city':r['city_name'],'slug':r['slug'],'title':r['title'],'description':r['description'] or '', 'description_len':len(r['description'] or ''),'photo_count':r['photo_count'],'photos':[{'id':p['id'],'caption':p['caption'] or '', 'thumb_url':'https://photomap.pl'+p['thumb_path']} for p in photos]},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
c.close()
PY
